goal: log-notify v0.1: Rust daemon that tails configured log files, matches per-source regexes, and emits freedesktop notifications through D-Bus.
active_goals: Documentation, architecture, ADRs, plan, and task list initialized (2026-11-26).
v0.1 implementation not started; next step is T1 (Cargo scaffold).
decisions: Rust stable, single binary, Linux only, synchronous single-threaded event loop, inotify-driven with no polling.
Read logs only; no native tool hooks; no replay or persistence; every source starts at end of file.
TOML config with serde; compile every regex at startup; fail loud with file, line, and reason.
zbus 5.x blocking API; urgency low/normal/critical = 0/1/2; critical never expires; missing daemon drops event and keeps tailing.
Per-source cooldown; schema default 0, shipped config uses 60/30/0 values from the spec.
Line cap default 8192 bytes; partial lines buffered; shrink resets offset; inode change reopens at end.
SIGHUP config reload deferred to v0.2; v0.1 requires restart.
Documentation-only initialization: no Cargo scaffold, source code, default config file, or CI workflow yet.
Template harness files (package.json, .opencode/, .agents/, scripts/, references/) are kept; project code goes under src/.
risks: Tracee pattern in the shipped default config is an unverified placeholder and a release blocker.
Missing or unreadable log source behavior is still an open question in tasks/plan.md.
No GitHub remote yet, so CI and release workflows cannot be validated.
zbus 6 removed the blocking API; v0.1 pins zbus 5.x and a future upgrade requires an async refactor.
Session-memory scripts fail on this host with Nix libc relocation errors; context-mode ctx_* tools and this state file are the working alternative.
Template Node/JS files remain in the repo because the OpenCode harness uses them; they are not the project stack.
next_actions: Resolve the open questions in tasks/plan.md before tail and notification implementation.
Start T1: create Cargo scaffold, rust-toolchain.toml, and module skeletons.
Create the GitHub remote before T2 so containerized CI can be validated.
Collect real tracee JSON and verify the tracee pattern before release.
Record the documentation initialization in CHANGELOG.md (done).
